# 74199 - 8-bit shift register

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74199.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74199.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,6,8,10,15,17,19,21 | QA..QH = Q[0..7] | Register bits. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK while CLOCK INHIBIT is low (the two inputs are gated together)

- CLEAR' low: QA..QH = L at once
- CLOCK INHIBIT high: hold
- SHIFT/LOAD' low: QA..QH = A..H at the clock edge
- SHIFT/LOAD' high: shift, QB..QH = QAn..QGn, and QA from J,K':
-   J=L, K'=H: QA = QAn (no change)
-   J=L, K'=L: QA = L
-   J=H, K'=H: QA = H
-   J=H, K'=L: QA = NOT QAn (toggle)

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| /CLEAR | QA..QH | PHL | 23 | 35 |
| CLOCK | QA..QH | PHL | 20 | 30 |
| CLOCK | QA..QH | PLH | 17 | 26 |
